Question: How do food manufacturers keep their formulations secret even from the handlers?
Answer: Once upon a time, I worked for one of the world's best flavours/fruit prep companies. And they had plants all over the globe. They had thousands of formulae and endless technology. For example, Can we make the same Pyramids of Egypt today even with modern technology/engineering? Can we make another Great Wall of China at present? Can we make another Taj Mahal, even with super technology and engineering? I believe we cannot replicate it. The story may be slightly different in small companies: Once upon a time, I worked in a medium cheese plant. I had complete know-how and hands-on experience, so I changed the job. In the other plant with my best efforts, I could not replicate the same success in another plant. , the processing lines and milk quality were not the same. Long and short: Recipes/formulas may not be secret. However, the whole process is a secret, and they fine-tuned the processes. These processes are the secret. These are my views: I hope it helps. Sam Arora: MSc Food Science U of Guelph, Canada MSc Dairy Science U of Punjab, NDRI, India

Question: Is it safe for people who are lactose intolerant to consume egg whites for breakfast without experiencing any digestive issues?
Answer: Lactose intolerance is caused by a deficiency of the enzyme lactase. This enzyme causes lactose to be unprocessed in the guts, which in turn causes digestive problems. Egg whites do not contain even a trace or let us zero percentage of lactose. Therefore, lactose intolerance has no bearing on consuming egg whites. Provided you are not allergic to egg whites. Lactose intolerance and Allegry are two different issues. I am not a medical doctor but a food/dairy/flavour scientist/chemist with lifelong experience in mega dairy/food/flavour processing plants. I hope it helps. Sam Arora: MSc Food Science U of Guelph, Canada MSc Dairy Science U of Punjab, NDRI, India
